note: Independent rejudge after replacing the test-only applyNextHopMod helper with the live precomputeNextHop and applyFactsNextHop producers. RFC 8277 Section 3.2.1 says: When a SAFI-4 or SAFI-128 route is propagated, if the Network Address of Next Hop field is left unchanged, the Label field(s) MUST also be left unchanged. TestLabeledPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels retains its SAFI-4 source bytes, empty modification-set assertion, complete MP_REACH byte equality, label/prefix equality and S-bit assertion. TestLabeledVPNPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels retains its SAFI-128 source bytes, empty modification-set assertion, complete attribute equality, twelve-octet VPN next hop, label, Route Distinguisher and prefix assertions. precomputeNextHop selects nhModeNone for NextHopUnchanged, applyFactsNextHop records no operation for that mode, and mpReachNextHopHandler takes its unchanged-source keepOrDrop branch when neither a next-hop Set nor an NLRI replacement exists. These assertions would detect loss or alteration of the preserved source attribute; they do not merely assert successful construction. The positive-only annotation still describes this conditional preservation obligation correctly and now cites the live producers without obsolete line numbers. Changed-next-hop behavior belongs to Section 3.2.2 and is not claimed by these tests. This rejudge is by source inspection, not a claim that the newly owed mutant observations or an interoperability scenario ran. Retain the enforced verdict with no scope expansion; the main thread must refresh the changed units' native discrimination observations before committing them.
